description: Calculate indicative financing costs for users considering borrowing against an investment portfolio. Accept portfolio value, requested financing amount, and selected term. When users have authorized access to connected financial information, relevant portfolio values and existing borrowing details may be used as calculation inputs, subject to applicable permissions and user consent. Return current Haven rates, advisory fees, estimated financing costs, loan-to-value ratios, and applicable eligibility and collateral risk disclosures. Do not request account credentials or unnecessarily detailed personal holdings.

collateralValue.description: Market value of the eligible brokerage portfolio pledged as collateral, in USD.

comparisonRatePercent.description: Annual rate to compare against, in percent (default 7.5, an approximate brokerage margin rate).

drawAmount.description: Cash to borrow, in USD. Minimum $50,000.

existingHavenBalance.description: Haven financing already outstanding against the same collateral, in USD. Default 0.

rateType.description: fixed: rate set for the term at execution. variable: resets monthly at the 1M rate.

term.description: Fixed-rate term: 3M, 6M, 12M (or 1Y) or 2Y. Ignored for variable financing.

name: simulate_financing
title: Simulate portfolio financing
